arguments: {"trial_id":"deliver","domain_id":"domain:missing","expected_revision":13,"answers":[{"question_id":"sq:missing:data-available","answer":"no_information","justification":"The approved Result is the full randomized-population time-to-first composite through follow-up (median 2.3 years), with HR 0.82 (95% CI 0.73–0.92).
